title: 5.6.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            arc length	
            \(s=rθ\)	

            area of a sector	
            \(A=\frac{1}{2}θ{r}^{2}\)	

            angular speed	
            \(ω=\frac{θ}{t}\)	

            linear speed	
            \(v=\frac{s}{t}\)	

            linear speed related to angular speed	
            \(v=rω\)	

            Cosine	
            \(cos t=x\)	

            Sine	
            \(sin t=y\)	

            Pythagorean Identity	
            \({cos}^{2}t+{sin}^{2}t=1\)	

            Tangent function	
            \(tan t=\frac{sint}{cost}\)	

            Secant function	
            \(sec t=\frac{1}{cost}\)	

            Cosecant function	
            \(csc t=\frac{1}{sint}\)	

            Cotangent function	
            \(cot t=\frac{1}{tan t}=\frac{cos t}{sin t}\)	

            Cofunction Identities	
            \(\begin{matrix}\begin{matrix}\\cos t=sin(\frac{π}{2}−t)\end{matrix}\\sin t=cos(\frac{π}{2}−t)\\tan t=cot(\frac{π}{2}−t)\\cot t=tan(\frac{π}{2}−t)\\sec t=csc(\frac{π}{2}−t)\\csc t=sec(\frac{π}{2}−t)\end{matrix}\)
